sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2023
sources.text: While underway, the master reported to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) that four perpetrators armed with knives were spotted in the engine room. The master sounded the alarm and mustered the crew, and conducted a search on board. It was discovered that some engine spares were stolen. No further sighting of the perpetrators. However, a crew was assaulted with minor head injury in the process. The master informed that no further assistance is required and resumed the passage to the next port of call.
